purpose: Transform an encounter specification into a deterministic multi-phase boss implementation plan and engine-specific scaffold.
hard_gates: Every damaging attack has a readable telegraph.
Every phase has at least one intended player counterplay path.
State transitions are deterministic and cannot move backward unless explicitly configured.
Victory condition cannot become impossible after a valid transition.
Damage windows and invulnerability rules are explicit.
All major tuning values are centralized.
Generated code is original and does not copy third-party implementations.
Generated output requires runtime validation in the target engine before release.
